input.code:
def process(all_years) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = all_years.copy()

    # Keep marine beaches only
    df = df[df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'marine']

    # Normalize violation values; treat missing/"null" as non-violation (safe)
    v = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    v = v.replace({'nan': 'no', 'none': 'no', 'null': 'no', '': 'no'})

    df = df.assign(_is_violation=v.eq('yes'))

    # Any beach with any violation across all records (2002-2023) is not "always safe"
    by_beach = df.groupby('Beach Name', dropna=False)['_is_violation'].any().reset_index(name='ever_violation')
    always_safe = by_beach[~by_beach['ever_violation']]

    return pd.DataFrame({'always_safe_marine_beach_count': [int(always_safe.shape[0])]})
input.summary: Filter to Marine beaches; normalize Violation (yes/no, case-insensitive; missing/'null' treated as no); for each Beach Name compute if any violation occurred 2002-2023; output count of beaches with no violations ever.
